# IWithdrawalQueue
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/lido/IWithdrawalQueue.sol)

**Title:**
IWithdrawalQueue

Interface for Lido's stETH withdrawal queue


## Functions
### requestWithdrawals

Requests withdrawals of stETH, creating one queued request per amount


```solidity
function requestWithdrawals(uint256[] memory amounts, address owner) external returns (uint256[] memory _requestIds);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amounts`|`uint256[]`|The stETH amounts to withdraw, one per request|
|`owner`|`address`|The address that can claim the resulting requests|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_requestIds`|`uint256[]`|The ids of the created withdrawal requests|


### claimWithdrawals

Claims multiple finalized withdrawal requests


```solidity
function claimWithdrawals(uint256[] memory _requestIds, uint256[] memory _hints) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_requestIds`|`uint256[]`|The ids of the requests to claim|
|`_hints`|`uint256[]`|Hints locating each request's finalization checkpoint|


### claimWithdrawal

Claims a single finalized withdrawal request


```solidity
function claimWithdrawal(uint256 _requestId) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_requestId`|`uint256`|The id of the request to claim|


### getWithdrawalRequests

Returns the ids of all withdrawal requests owned by an account


```solidity
function getWithdrawalRequests(address owner) external view returns (uint256[] memory _requestIds);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner`|`address`|The account to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_requestIds`|`uint256[]`|The owner's withdrawal request ids|


### getWithdrawalStatus

Returns the status of the given withdrawal requests


```solidity
function getWithdrawalStatus(uint256[] memory _requestIds)
    external
    view
    returns (WithdrawalRequestStatus[] memory _status);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_requestIds`|`uint256[]`|The request ids to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_status`|`WithdrawalRequestStatus[]`|The status of each requested withdrawal|


### finalize

Finalizes withdrawal requests up to a given id


```solidity
function finalize(uint256 _lastRequestIdToBeFinalized, uint256 _timestamp) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_lastRequestIdToBeFinalized`|`uint256`|The highest request id to finalize|
|`_timestamp`|`uint256`|The finalization timestamp|


## Structs
### WithdrawalRequestStatus
Status of a withdrawal request in the queue


```solidity
struct WithdrawalRequestStatus {
    /// @notice stETH token amount that was locked on withdrawal queue for this request
    uint256 amountOfStETH;
    /// @notice amount of stETH shares locked on withdrawal queue for this request
    uint256 amountOfShares;
    /// @notice address that can claim or transfer this request
    address owner;
    /// @notice timestamp of when the request was created, in seconds
    uint256 timestamp;
    /// @notice true, if request is finalized
    bool isFinalized;
    /// @notice true, if request is claimed. Request is claimable if (isFinalized && !isClaimed)
    bool isClaimed;
}
```
